title: Among patients with abnormal alkaline phosphatase (ALP ≥ 300) and creatinin
question: Among patients with abnormal alkaline phosphatase (ALP ≥ 300) and creatinine outside the normal range (≥1.5), determine whether males outnumber females—considering only those who either have severe thrombosis (levels 1 or 2) or a normal prothrombin time (PT < 14). Return 'True' if there are more such males than females, otherwise 'False'.

SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_058" FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014" WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'M' AND (T2."XCL_021" <= 3.5 OR T2."XCL_021" >= 5.5) ORDER BY T1."XCL_060" DESC

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2."XCL_035" >= 14 AND T1."XCL_059" = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014" WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060") > 55

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_063 = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 
             SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_063 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        THEN 'True' 
        ELSE 'False' 
    END AS result
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE l.XCL_020 >= 300 
  AND l.XCL_021 >= 1.5
  AND (l.XCL_023 IN (1, 2) OR l.XCL_024 < 14)
